text: The CSIRO Drought Resilience Mission is an initiative aimed at reducing the impacts of drought in Australia by 30% by 2030. It is part of CSIRO's larger Missions program, which addresses national challenges through collaborative R&D efforts. The mission focuses on climate-related drought risks affecting agriculture, water security, and regional communities. It employs a three-level intervention model that includes on-farm innovation, regional resilience, and policy enablers to tackle drought as a systemic risk.
